paragraphs: Fortis Corporate Services (Pvt) Ltd, established in 2017, is a professional firm providing corporate, legal, HR, accounting, branding, marketing and related business services to clients in Sri Lanka and overseas.

Our team comprises experienced legal professionals with a strong legal heritage, together with business professionals with practical experience in corporate and commercial matters. This combination allows us to approach each matter with both legal knowledge and a clear understanding of the commercial considerations involved.

We handle matters of varying size and complexity, with a focus on professionalism, accuracy, confidentiality and timely delivery. We understand the importance of meeting deadlines and providing clients with practical, well-considered solutions, particularly where matters involve significant business or commercial value.
Our objective is to build long-term professional relationships with our clients by providing dependable advice and support tailored to their individual requirements.
